environmentVariables.name: SEICHE_MCP_PUBLIC
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the eleven free public tools shipped by seiche 0.11.1 over stdio: latest_article, funding_stress_now, historical_analogs, proof_backtest, data_health, crypto_stress_record, institutional_flows, oil_funding_context, fx_materials_passage, money_market_context, world_markets_context.

entries.description: Eleven anonymous, read-only tools for the latest full-text editorial, current US dollar funding regime, historical analogs, data health, institutional positioning, crypto transmission, oil/FX/material context, granular money-market context, bounded world-markets context, and a historical diagnostic with misses and eligibility flags.
representativeQueries: What is the current US dollar funding stress regime?
What historical episodes most resemble today?
How are hedge funds positioned in the Treasury basis trade?
Are oil, FX or material cash demands—including current Cushing stocks and Brent−WTI basis—reaching dollar funding markets, and which structure figures are dated references?
Give me a bounded money, FX and capital-markets briefing with source clocks, evidence statuses and canonical citations.

entries.displayName: Seiche Market Atlas Corpus MCP Server

data.name: io.github.beepboop2025/seiche-market-corpus
data.title: Seiche Market Atlas — structured evidence corpus
data.description: Rights-aware attested evidence objects, structural inspection, bounded full-fidelity BIS records, revisions and canonical Seiche market discovery with explicit evidence clocks.

entries.description: Public, read-only discovery and rights-approved record access across the Hetzner market evidence lake. Verified unique objects are bound to an immutable public index; structural profiles disclose shape without leaking values, and restricted collections remain metadata-only.
representativeQueries: Which money, forex and capital-market datasets are registered, and what rights and evidence classes apply?
Inspect one immutable dataset object, its structural profile, hashes and publication boundary.
Page through the full normalized BIS global-liquidity records without mixing source generations.
Show the series key, dimensions, event time, knowledge time, revision and source attribution for a BIS record.
Which Seiche canonical market partitions and protected exports are currently present?

entries.description: Curated OpenAPI contract for money markets, 22 public FX reference series, capital-market transmission, metadata-only China macro evidence, current funding conditions, provenance, methodology and health endpoints.
representativeQueries: Give me an API for the current dollar funding regime.
Retrieve repo, reserves and Treasury cash conditions with provenance.
Check whether the Seiche data feeds are fresh.
Retrieve compact oil-funding, live-vs-reference market structure and FX-material transmission context.
Retrieve a bounded money, FX, capital-markets and metadata-only China macro context with source clocks, status vocabulary and canonical citation URLs.

entries.description: A bounded, source-linked 21 August 2026 receipt for 11 registered money markets: six raw public benchmarks, one derived-context benchmark, one policy-only market, three declared gaps, and 52 discovery candidates. It is not a universal world-economy score.
representativeQueries: Which global money markets have a redistributable public overnight benchmark in Seiche?
Where can I retrieve source-linked SOFR, ESTR, TONA, SORA, AONIA and Indian call-rate context?
Which Seiche money-market packs expose only derived context, only a policy anchor or no eligible observation?
Does Seiche publish a universal global money-market or world-economy stress score?
How should an AI cite Seiche's global money-market coverage and live observations?

entries.description: A versioned, cache-only context joining money markets, 22 public FX reference series, three dollar indexes, capital-market transmission and four release-reviewed metadata-only NBS China macro identities. The structural China catalog is unsigned; only a restricted response carries verified Seiche owner-attested provenance. Source clocks, canonical citation URLs and explicit observed, derived, structural, restricted and unavailable states travel with the response.
capabilities: unsigned structural or verified restricted NBS China macro metadata
representativeQueries: Give me a sourced overview of current money, forex and capital-market conditions with canonical Seiche pages and source clocks.
Which 22 currency reference series does Seiche cover and what are their quote conventions?
How are Treasury supply, dealer balance sheets, credit spreads and futures positioning connected to funding liquidity?
Which NBS China macro series identities are release-reviewed, is a verified restricted revision present, and which values remain withheld?
Which parts of Seiche's world-market coverage are observed, derived, structural, restricted or unavailable?

entries.displayName: Liquidity Lab Financial Evidence Agent Skill
entries.description: A portable Agent Skill that routes money-market, capital-market, China-economy, financial-institution-risk and market-liquidity research across Seiche, LiquiLens, Undertow and Palimpsest while preserving source rights, evidence classes and distinct clocks.
capabilities: observation, publication, knowledge and retrieval clock preservation
representativeQueries: Build a sourced money-market research packet and route any institution or exit questions to the correct product.
Trace a capital-market repricing into funding, bank and market-liquidity evidence without claiming causality.
Research China's economy while keeping official macro metadata and information-control evidence separate.
Which Liquidity Lab product should answer a bank-risk or market-liquidity question?
Fetch bounded public JSON for money-market, capital-market and China-economy topics without treating failed sources as zero.

entries.description: A rights-reviewed, source-pinned research snapshot containing 11,163 observations from ten direct Office of Financial Research series. Runtime caches, FRED-fetched values, restricted rows and Seiche-derived outputs are excluded; the draft has no DOI.
representativeQueries: Where can I find Seiche's audited direct-OFR repo and money-market-fund dataset?
Which OFR series and observation clocks are included in the Seiche research snapshot?
How do I verify the hashes, source revision and rights boundary for Seiche's academic dataset?
Has the direct-OFR Seiche dataset been assigned a DOI?
